The season premiere released on [[March 1]], [[2023]], and takes place after the events of the series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]''. ==Official description== ''The journeys of [[Din Djarin|the Mandalorian]] through the [[Star Wars]] [[The galaxy|galaxy]] continue. Once a lone [[bounty hunter]], Din Djarin has [[Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor|reunited]] with [[Din Grogu|Grogu]]. Meanwhile, the [[New Republic]] struggles to lead the [[galaxy]] away from its dark history. The [[Mandalorian]] will cross paths with old allies and make new enemies as he and Grogu continue their journey together.'' ==Episodes== {|class="wikitable sortable" {{Prettytable}} |- bgcolor="#CCCCCC" ! [[April 12]], 2023 {{C|[[Disney+]]}} || 3-7 |- | 24 || [[File:Chapter24-TheReturn.png|150px]] || "[[Chapter 24: The Return]]" || [[April 19]], 2023 || 3-8 |- |} ==Development== On [[October 15]], [[2020]], series executive producer and writer [[Jon Favreau]] told [[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|Variety]] that ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' was on schedule to begin production before the end of the year. According to [[Phil Szostak]], the [[Lucasfilm]] art department began concept art production in [[November]] [[2019]], days before the launch of the [[The Mandalorian Season One|first season]].{{Twitter|PhilSzostak|status/1316815917087518725|[[Phil Szostak]]|quote=We've been busy little bees in the Lucasfilm art department, having started work on Season 3 back in November of 2019, just days before Disney+ launched and Season 1 dropped.|archivedate=20201016152045}} On [[December 10]], 2020, [[Kathleen Kennedy]] teased that the "next chapter" of ''The Mandalorian'' would arrive on [[December 24|Christmas]] of [[2021]].{{DisneyCompany|url=disney-investor-day-2020|text=Disney Investor Day 2020}} However, on [[December 21]], 2020, Favreau appeared on [[Wikipedia:Good Morning America|''Good Morning America'']] on the [[ABC Television Network]], and clarified that ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'' is currently in production, and will be released in [[December]] 2021, while the third season of ''The Mandalorian'' will go into production after the filming of ''The Book of Boba Fett'' is completed.{{OfficialYouTube|channel=@GMA|name=Good Morning America|link=Wikipedia:Good Morning America|video=uwwrezdcLiA|text=Jon Favreau talks about the season 2 finale of 'The Mandalorian'|archivedate=20201222032423}} A [[StarWars.com]] post later that day reiterated this, and stated that ''The Mandalorian'' Season Three would go into production in 2021.{{SW|url=news/the-book-of-boba-fett|text=''The Book of Boba Fett'', a New Series, Coming December 2021 on Disney+}} An [[Wikipedia:Above the Treeline#Edelweiss+|Edelweiss+]] announcement for ''[[The Mandalorian: The Rescue|The Mandalorian: Boba Fett Returns]]'' stated that Season 3 would release in Spring [[2022]]. However, the page was removed and ''Boba Fett Returns'' was retitled to ''The Mandalorian: The Rescue''.{{LegacyEdelweiss|url=#sku=0736441670&page=1|text=The Mandalorian: Boba Fett Returns (Star Wars)}} Filming began in [[September]] 2021,{{WebCite|url=https://chipandco.com/carl-weathers-shares-the-mandalorian-season-3-will-begin-filming-next-month-441736|text=Carl Weathers Shares 'The Mandalorian' Season 3 Will Begin Filming Next Month|date=2021-08-17|work=[https://chipandco.com Chip and Company]|archivedate=20210818173730}} and wrapped in [[March]] 2022.{{Twitter|TheCarlWeathers|status/1508909533074182148|[[Carl Weathers]]|quote=...And what a season of WONDERFULNESS!|archivedate=20220331100551}} The spinoff series ''The Book of Boba Fett'' premiered on [[December 29]], 2021,{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1443229087980457986|[[Star Wars]]|quote=His story is only beginning. The Book of @BobaFett, an all-new Original Series, starts streaming December 29 on @DisneyPlus. #TheBookOfBobaFett|archivedate=20210929154550}} and featured several characters that appeared in ''The Mandalorian'' after the events of the second season.{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}} The third season takes place after the events of ''The Book of Boba Fett''. During ''[[Celebration Anaheim (2022)|Celebration Anaheim]]'' in 2022, it was announced that the season will premiere in [[February]] [[2023]], and an exclusive teaser was shown.{{SW|url=news/swca-2022-20-highlights-from-lucasfilms-studio-showcase|text=SWCA 2022: 20 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase}} It was also announced that [[Rick Famuyiwa]] will executive produce and direct in the third season. On [[September 10]], 2022, a teaser for the season was publicly released.{{SWYouTube|odnRRZKhNPk|The Mandalorian Season Three | Teaser Trailer | Disney Plus}} On [[December 1]], 2022, it was delayed to [[March 1]], 2023. On [[January 16]], 2023, the official trailer and poster were released during halftime of the [[Wikipedia:NFL playoffs|NFL Super Wild Card matchup]]. ''Star Wars'' Hong Kong announced on [[Wikipedia:Facebook|Facebook]] that [[Boba Fett]] would return in ''The Mandalorian'' Season Three, however the post was later deleted.{{Facebook|username=starwarshongkong|url=starwarshongkong/posts/pfbid02yrADjJUjwoALnTMb8x2amM9cSouPmNQSWhyRMsK5wfW4wMQn2NcVq7fgKJyfZvMwl|name=''[[Star Wars]]''|quote=原班人馬重磅回歸🔥 曼達洛人 #DinDjarin 同尤達BB #古古 即將揭開全新冒險旅程！加上傳奇賞金獵人#BobaFett 同其他老盟友、新敵人！仲有曼達洛人經常講嘅「This is the way！」。煲劇之前，快啲記清楚💫！|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/XqzTf|nolive=1}} Fett ultimately did not appear in the season. ==Credits==
